d1m1-a2.title: Peach State Lien Ledger Audit
d1m1-a2.kicker: Call every line: the collision's care, unrelated, pre-existing, or claimed above what was paid
d1m1-a2.intro: 06/10/2026. Peach State's interim itemization asserts $3,618.00 against John Doe's recovery. Before any figure goes into the lien register or the demand, every line is checked against the treatment record, the PIP Log and what the plan actually paid.

items.what: Member ID, group and recovery file
items.as: PSH-55017742 · GRP-41208 · SRU-26-03318; member John Doe; date of incident 02/06/2026
items.issue: The identifiers match the plan's 02/27/2026 notice and the lien register, so every later letter, the reduction request and the final payoff tie to one recovery file.
items.fix: Confirm the three numbers against the notice and the lien register before the dispute goes out; no change.

items.as: Fully insured group policy issued to Northgate Distribution
items.issue: Funding status decides which law governs any reduction later. It matches the plan's notice, so the lien register records it as stated.
items.fix: Record fully insured in the lien register; which law governs a reduction is Atty. Thorne's call, at the lien stage.

items.as: INTERIM ITEMIZATION — subject to change as claims are processed
items.issue: An interim figure is not a lien amount. Carried into the lien register or the demand, it lets Peach State move the number at disbursement, and the Net Sheet will not tie.
items.fix: Ask in the dispute for a corrected itemization confirmed in writing, stating that no other accident-related claims are in process; Case Manager, by email.

items.as: Routine eye exam; paid $95.00 on 02/17/2026; claimed $95.00
items.issue: The date of service is before the 02/06/2026 collision. Left in, Peach State recovers from John Doe's settlement for care that has nothing to do with the claim.
items.fix: Dispute the line in writing as before the loss and unrelated; Case Manager, in the dispute email.

items.as: Billed $2,395.00; denied 03/27/2026, other coverage primary (PIP); claimed $0.00
items.issue: Correct as stated: Harbor Point PIP paid the MRI in full on 03/25/2026, so the plan paid nothing and claims nothing.
items.fix: Confirm against the PIP Log and Summit's invoice; note in the register that the line stays at $0.00.

items.as: Telehealth visit for acute sinusitis; paid $49.00; claimed $49.00
items.issue: A sinus infection is not a collision injury. Left in, the plan's claim against the settlement grows for care the treatment record never ties to the crash.
items.fix: Dispute the line as unrelated by its diagnosis code; Case Manager, in writing.

items.as: Established-patient visit for allergic rhinitis; paid $74.00; claimed $74.00
items.issue: An established-patient visit for a condition he had before the collision: pre-existing, and unrelated to the neck injury the claim is built on.
items.fix: Dispute the line as a pre-existing, unrelated condition; Case Manager, in writing.

items.as: Billed $3,400.00; allowed and paid $1,860.00 on 06/03/2026; claimed $3,400.00
items.issue: The ledger's own paid column shows $1,860.00. Claiming the billed $3,400.00 would take the $1,540.00 in-network write-off, which the plan never paid, out of John Doe's net.
items.fix: Ask Peach State to correct the line to the $1,860.00 it paid: a plan's reimbursement claim is what it paid.

items.issue: With the three unrelated lines out and Crescent at what was paid, the related claim is $1,860.00. Carried at $3,618.00, the lien register and the Net Sheet overstate what John Doe owes the plan.
items.fix: Show $3,618.00 asserted and under dispute; change the register only when Peach State confirms the corrected figure in writing.

items.as: Reimbursed first, in full, without reduction for attorney fees or costs; remit within 30 days of any settlement
items.issue: Agreeing, or answering as if agreed, could give up a reduction for procurement costs that state law may allow on a fully insured plan. That is a legal position, not a filing task.
items.fix: Flag to Atty. Thorne with the plan's notice and, once received, the certificate's provision; commit to nothing on repayment, amount or timing.

items.as: Notify the plan in writing before any settlement is reached
items.issue: The same condition as the plan's 02/27/2026 notice. Honoring it costs nothing and keeps the plan from claiming its rights were prejudiced.
items.fix: Calendar it against the settlement steps; the notice is sent, never a promise of payment.

items.as: Not enclosed: plan documents available on written request
items.issue: Without the certificate's own language no one can test what the plan may claim or how it can be reduced, and Atty. Thorne needs it before the lien stage.
items.fix: Request the certificate's reimbursement provision in the dispute email; Case Manager.

items.as: Not on the itemization
items.issue: Correctly absent: Riverton Spine & Rehab is out of network and treats under the LOP signed 02/23/2026, so the plan paid nothing and has nothing to claim.
items.fix: Confirm that the LOP balance is tracked in its own register entry, never on Peach State's lien.

d1m1-a2.revealNote: Peach State's corrected itemization of 06/24/2026: the reimbursement claim confirmed in writing at $1,860.00. The pre-demand audit, the demand and the lien stage all work from this figure.
revealPoints: Reimbursement claim confirmed in writing: $1,860.00 as of 06/24/2026
Three lines removed: 02/03/2026 before the loss; 03/18/2026 and 05/06/2026 unrelated
Crescent Pain & Spine corrected from the billed $3,400.00 to the $1,860.00 paid
Summit Imaging stays at $0.00: denied, PIP primary
No other accident-related claims in process; the certificate's Section 11 enclosed
Any reduction is Atty. Thorne's, at the lien stage

d2m4-wage.title: Lost Wage Worksheet Audit
d2m4-wage.kicker: Match every missed shift to the employer's record and the treating provider's note
d2m4-wage.intro: 07/01/2026, the day the Specials audit is due. Northgate's records came on 06/30/2026; the draft worksheet was built from John Doe's memory a week earlier. Call every row against the employer's records and the treating providers' notes, so no absence is left unexcused.

items.as: Northgate Distribution, $22.00 per hour
items.issue: Matches Northgate's letter and its Wage Loss Verification Form: the rate the whole wage claim multiplies.
items.fix: Confirm against the employer's letter and form; no change.

items.as: 8 hours
items.issue: Northgate records 8-hour day shifts, 40 hours a week, so each missed shift is 8 hours at $22.00, $176.00.
items.fix: Confirm against the payroll records; no change.

items.as: Excluded: before first treatment, no doctor's note
items.issue: Northgate records all five unpaid as call-outs for neck pain. Dropped, the claim loses $880.00 and the file hides the gap's best corroboration; Keystone will find the call-outs anyway.
items.fix: Restore the five shifts and flag them to Atty. Thorne with the call-out record, the EMS report and the 02/07/2026 receipt; how they are presented is his call.

items.as: Missed, neck pain; client's account; $176.00 each
items.issue: He worked both shifts, as the urgent-care history and Northgate's records show. An adjuster who checks payroll would discredit the whole wage claim on these two rows.
items.fix: Remove both rows, noting the record that disproves them; Case Manager.

items.as: Orthopedic consult, Lakeside Orthopedics
items.issue: Northgate records a medical appointment, and Dr. Reyes's consult note dates the visit: the absence is excused by the record.
items.fix: Attach the consult note as the shift's support.

items.as: MRI; client's account
items.issue: The MRI was 03/13/2026, and Northgate's unpaid shift is 03/13. A date that matches neither record invites the adjuster to call the shift unsupported.
items.fix: Correct the row to 03/13/2026 and attach Summit's MRI report.

items.as: Injection, Crescent Pain & Spine
items.issue: The procedure note and Northgate's record agree on the date: the injection excuses the shift.
items.fix: Attach the procedure note as the shift's support.

items.as: Doctor said rest; client's account; no note attached
items.issue: A recollection is not support. Crescent's work note puts him off work 05/15–05/18/2026, and Northgate holds it on file; without it the shift reads as unexcused.
items.fix: Replace the support with Crescent's work note; Case Manager.

items.as: Reduced hours under the urgent-care restrictions, about 20 hours, $440.00
items.issue: Northgate accommodated the restrictions at full shifts and full pay; no hours were lost. Claimed, it is a figure the employer's own form contradicts.
items.fix: Strike the line and note that the restrictions were worked at full shifts.

items.as: 4 hours a week for 2 weeks: 8 hours at $33.00, $264.00
items.issue: No overtime was scheduled on any missed shift. Overtime is claimed only when the employer confirms it was scheduled and lost.
items.fix: Strike the line, citing Northgate's form.

items.issue: Nine verified shifts at 8 hours and $22.00 come to $1,584.00. Any other total puts a figure in the Specials the employer will not support.
items.fix: Replace with $1,584.00 and carry it to the Specials and the Net Sheet.

items.as: 80% of $1,760.00 = $1,408.00, to be claimed from Harbor Point
items.issue: PIP was exhausted on 06/26/2026, so the 80% benefit was never payable. Recording a pending PIP payment would net money out of the Specials that will never come.
items.fix: Record the benefit as not payable; the full $1,584.00 stays in the Specials.

items.as: Request from Northgate
items.issue: Northgate hired him on 01/12/2026 and has no 2025 W-2. The request would stall: his 2025 earnings were with Riverton Freight Services.
items.fix: Ask John Doe for his 2025 W-2 from Riverton Freight Services.

items.as: Yes, permanent: residual arm numbness (client)
items.issue: Dr. Reyes released him to full duty at MMI on 06/12/2026. Earning capacity is a medical and legal opinion; asserted by staff, it is the first line defense counsel tests.
items.fix: Flag to Atty. Thorne with the MMI note; the Case Manager records facts only.

items.as: Requested 06/22/2026, pending: no employer form, payroll records or job description behind any row
items.issue: Without the employer's form and payroll records every row rests on memory, and the physical demands (lifting to 50 lb, forklift) are what tie the restrictions to the job.
items.fix: Add Northgate's Wage Loss Verification Form, payroll records and letter as the worksheet's sources; Case Manager.

d2m4-wage.revealNote: The Lost Wage Verification Record of 07/01/2026: nine shifts, each matched to Northgate's record and, after 02/20/2026, a provider's note: $1,584.00. The Specials audit and the demand work from it.
revealPoints: 02/09–02/13/2026 kept and flagged to Atty. Thorne, with the call-out record
03/05, 03/13, 05/15 and 05/18/2026 each matched to a provider record
No overtime and no light-duty hours lost; the draft's $1,760.00 struck
PIP's 80% wage benefit not payable: exhausted 06/26/2026

d1m1-a2.title: Lien Dispute & Written Confirmation — Peach State
d1m1-a2.kicker: Send the line-by-line dispute, get the corrected balance in writing, and file the exchange
d1m1-a2.to: Dion Carver, Peach State Health Plan (dcarver@peachstatehealth.example)
d1m1-a2.subject: Member PSH-55017742 · Recovery file SRU-26-03318 — itemized lien dispute
d1m1-a2.attachment: Peach State's interim itemization of 06/10/2026, marked line by line
d1m1-a2.brief: Dispute the interim itemization in writing, line by line: the three lines that are not the collision's, and Crescent claimed above what the plan paid. Ask for a corrected itemization confirmed in writing and the plan's reimbursement provision. Commit to nothing on repayment or reduction: that is Atty. Thorne's.

required.label: Names the member ID or the recovery file
required.hint: Name PSH-55017742 or SRU-26-03318 so the plan finds the file.

required.label: Names the three unrelated lines by date
required.hint: Name 02/03, 03/18 and 05/06, and say why each is not the collision's care.

required.label: Puts Crescent at what the plan paid
required.hint: The plan's claim is what it paid: $1,860.00, not the $3,400.00 billed.

required.label: Asks for a corrected itemization, confirmed in writing
required.hint: Ask for the corrected balance in writing, not by phone.

required.label: Routes repayment and terms to Atty. Thorne
required.hint: Questions on what the plan will accept go to Atty. Thorne, by name.

reply.from: Dion Carver, Peach State Health Plan (dcarver@peachstatehealth.example)
reply.subject: RE: Member PSH-55017742 · Recovery file SRU-26-03318 — itemized lien dispute
reply.body:
Thank you for your email of June 12. We have reviewed the claim records and agree with your findings. The Riverton Vision Center, Peach State Virtual Care and Riverton Allergy & Asthma Clinic claims are removed as unrelated, and the Crescent Pain & Spine line is corrected to the $1,860.00 the Plan paid. Summit Imaging remains at $0.00.

The Plan's reimbursement claim is $1,860.00 as of today, and no other accident-related claims are in process. Our corrected itemization and Section 11 of the certificate are attached. Please notify us before any settlement and request a final amount before disbursement.

Dion Carver · Recovery Analyst · Peach State Health Plan · SRU-26-03318

press.from: Dion Carver, Peach State Health Plan
press.subject: RE: RE: Member PSH-55017742 — one more thing
press.body: One more thing so I can close my review. Can you confirm in writing that Mr. Doe will repay the $1,860.00 in full from his settlement, without reduction? And what are the liability carrier's limits, and when do you expect the case to settle? It would help us plan.

choices.label: Confirm full repayment: the figure is now right, so agreeing costs nothing
choices.why: A written promise of full repayment can waive a reduction Atty. Thorne may seek at the lien stage. Repayment terms are his.

choices.label: Acknowledge the $1,860.00, confirm notice before any settlement, and route the repayment and limits questions to Atty. Thorne
choices.why: The facts are acknowledged, the plan's notice condition is honored, and every legal position and disclosure stays with the attorney, routed the same day.

choices.label: Give him Keystone's $10,000 limit and a likely settlement month so he can plan
choices.why: What a lienholder is told is counsel's call, and a settlement date is a prediction the Case Manager never makes.

d2m4-wage.title: Employer Wage Verification — Northgate Distribution
d2m4-wage.kicker: Request the employer's own verification, answer its follow-up, and file the exchange
d2m4-wage.to: Angela Ruiz, HR Manager, Northgate Distribution (aruiz@northgatedistribution.example)
d2m4-wage.subject: John Doe (Employee ID NGD-20417) — wage and attendance verification request
d2m4-wage.attachment: Employee authorization signed by John Doe 06/22/2026
d2m4-wage.brief: Ask Northgate for its own records: the Wage Loss Verification Form, payroll records and his W-2, and confirmation of his rate, shift hours, each missed date, any overtime lost and the job's physical demands. Share no medical records and nothing about the claim's value.

required.label: Lists the missed dates to verify
required.hint: Name 02/09 through 02/13, 03/05, 03/13, 05/15 and 05/18 so each is confirmed or corrected.

required.label: Asks for his hourly rate and shift hours
required.hint: The claim multiplies the rate by the hours: ask for both.

required.label: Asks whether any overtime was lost
required.hint: Overtime is claimed only if the employer confirms it was scheduled and lost.

required.label: Asks for payroll records or paystubs, and the W-2
required.hint: Ask for paystubs or payroll records for the affected pay periods, and his W-2.

required.label: Asks for the physical demands of his job
required.hint: The job's physical demands tie the doctors' restrictions to the work.

required.label: Asks for the Wage Loss Verification Form
required.hint: Ask the employer to complete the verification form, not just to write back.

reply.subject: RE: John Doe (NGD-20417) — wage and attendance verification
reply.body:
Attached are our wage and attendance letter and the completed Wage Loss Verification Form with payroll records for the three pay periods. To summarize: Mr. Doe is paid $22.00 an hour on 8-hour day shifts. Payroll shows nine unpaid shifts, 72 hours, $1,584.00: 02/09 through 02/13, 03/05, 03/13, 05/15 and 05/18/2026. No overtime was scheduled on any of them. The restrictions from 02/20 and 03/05/2026 were handled within his role at full shifts, with no hours lost. The job requires lifting to 50 lb, forklift work and being on his feet all shift. We have no 2025 W-2 for him; he started 01/12/2026.

Angela Ruiz · HR Manager · Northgate Distribution · (555) 010-6600

press.subject: RE: one more question
press.body: One more question from our benefits coordinator. Will John's settlement pay him back for those days, so we know how to code them? And could you send us his MRI and his doctors' notes so we can update his restrictions file?

choices.label: Send the MRI and the notes: Northgate has cooperated, and the records are already on file
choices.why: His authorization lets Northgate give records to the firm, not the reverse. Sending his medical records to his employer breaches his privacy.

choices.label: Tell her yes: lost wages are part of the claim, so he will be repaid at settlement
choices.why: That predicts a recovery and discusses his claim with a third party. What the claim recovers is Atty. Thorne's to discuss, with John Doe.

choices.label: Thank her, send no records, say work-status notes come from John and his providers, and route the claim question to Atty. Thorne
choices.why: His privacy is kept, Northgate still gets restrictions from the proper source, and the claim question reaches the attorney the same day.
